about: The definition of the walk scoreboard. Hand edited. A cell's status is never written here: it comes only from run files in the runs folder (see watch/walk_scoreboard.py).
built_from: GOAL-NOVAHOS done_when, lines 1 to 15, copied word for word on 2026-11-23 from QUEUE-v2.json (NODE novah estate part 13 handoff folder, item GOAL-NOVAHOS)
33 spokes from spokes.json (SPOKES.md, written 2026-11-21 by a read-only analyst; a code read, not a run)
machine grid from queue item fold-c-proof; spoke matrix from queue item fold-s-local-run
protect lines from queue item p16-1 and the Stage 1 and Stage 2 exit tests in QUEUE-v2.md
notes: Two backups: the planning notes name vzdump and vault-sync as the backups in the Stage 1 exit test. That pairing is a reading of those notes, not something the owner confirmed.
Closed by design lowers the number a cell is counted against, so a run file may close a cell only on the owner's own decision and must say where he made it.

sections.title: The 15 lines of the root goal
sections.blurb: GOAL-NOVAHOS is done when the owner has walked all fifteen lines himself. Each line is one cell.

cells.label: Line 1: One icon, one window
cells.text: On GREYWOLF he opens one NovahOS icon. One window opens. No other program has to be started first.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 2: Sign in once, same rooms on the Surface
cells.text: He signs in once. He signs in again on the Surface with the same account and sees the same rooms and the same history.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 3: Walk every room and mark it
cells.text: He walks every room in the window (command center, Atlas, reports, approvals, Prime voice, Character Design, Decompress, Home Node controls, documents) and marks each pass or fail on one checklist page.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 4: Three questions only his own data can answer
cells.text: He asks the brain three questions only his own data can answer (something said on Fieldy last week, a number from QuickBooks, a person from his mail). Each answer names where it came from.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 5: Network cable out, the local brain answers
cells.text: He pulls the network cable and asks one of them again. The local model answers from the local brain. Nothing leaves the machine.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 6: Every spoke runs one real task on the local node
cells.text: For each spoke on the list (hub, odyssey, reach, signal, scope, orbit, echo, lucid, inbound, scout, money, Fieldy, self, Prime) he starts one real task from the window. It runs once on the local node and files its own report. The grid shows pass, fail or 'closed by design' in every cell.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 7: An odyssey pursuit that is not a job
cells.text: He gives odyssey a pursuit that is not a job (one person, one client). It plans, drafts and stops for his approval before anything is sent.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 8: Approve one action, reject one
cells.text: An action that would send, post or spend shows up as one approval in the window. He approves one and rejects one. Nothing went out before his click, and the rejected one never goes out.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 9: The iPhone away from home answers a card
cells.text: He opens NovahOS on the iPhone away from home. He sees the same rooms, answers one question card, and the desk that asked gets his answer.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 10: Level 1, a side quest, a mission and a boss
cells.text: He plays level 1, one side quest, one mission and one boss in the window. Each records an outcome in the brain.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 11: One job and one model call placed on another machine
cells.text: From the window he starts one job and one model call. The job router places the job on another machine and the one model service answers. The window shows where each ran.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 12: GREYWOLF off for a day
cells.text: He switches GREYWOLF off for a day. Every timed job still runs, the brain still answers from the phone and the Surface, and nothing is lost.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 13: Restore one backup; backups and off-machine copy pass
cells.text: He restores one backup to a scratch machine and it boots. Last night's backups and the off-machine copy all show a pass line.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 14: A fresh Windows machine, installer, step 1
cells.text: A fresh Windows machine gets the installer, and step 1 works there without a desk helping.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

cells.label: Line 15: One full working day from NovahOS only
cells.text: He runs one full working day from NovahOS only. Every fail he marks becomes a queue item with an owner; when the list is empty, the goal is closed.
cells.needs: The owner walks this line himself. A desk records his result with his own words as the source and one evidence file.

sections.title: Machine grid
sections.blurb: Each machine must take one job from the job router and answer one model call, or be closed by design.

columns.label: Job placed
columns.needs: The job router places one job on this machine and the window shows where it ran.

columns.label: Model answered
columns.needs: One model call is answered by the model service on this machine and the window shows where it ran.

sections.title: Protect lines
sections.blurb: The nightly jobs that keep the estate recoverable. A result older than its limit reads unknown.

cells.label: Backup 1: Proxmox nightly backup of the vault VM
cells.needs: Proxmox job vault-nightly, 02:15 Pacific. Read the job's task log: finished OK, size recorded.
cells.claim: from queue item P07 (planning notes, not re-checked here)

cells.label: Backup 2: vault-sync on overlord
cells.needs: Cron vault-sync on overlord, 02:45 on its clock. Read its status line after the run: OK with a file count.
cells.claim: from the Stage 1 exit test and the devices inventory of 2026-11-21 (planning notes, not re-checked here)

cells.label: State pull: greywolf-state-pull
cells.needs: Cron on overlord, 04:10 Pacific. Read /var/log/greywolf-state.status: an OK line with a tar newer than the last one.
cells.claim: from queue item machines-7 (planning notes, not re-checked here)

cells.label: Off-machine copy: VAULT private sync from this PC
cells.needs: Task VAULT private sync, 04:30 Pacific. Run python watch/walk_scoreboard.py probe off-machine, which reads the sync log with watch/vault_sync_status.py: ok means exit 0 and a verified push of every target.
cells.claim: from queue item sooner-4; reader watch/vault_sync_status.py (planning notes, not re-checked here)

cells.label: Restore: one backup restored to a scratch machine boots
cells.needs: Restore a small VM backup to a scratch id, boot it, record the result.
cells.claim: from queue item desks-1-9 (planning notes, not re-checked here)

cells.label: Nightly full run: a verdict on hub main
cells.needs: The nightly full serial run writes PASS or FAIL. UNKNOWN or SKIPPED-BUSY is not a pass. Run python watch/walk_scoreboard.py probe nightly-full-run, which reads the last line of its log.
cells.claim: from queue item U02; runner watch/nightly_full_run.py (planning notes, not re-checked here)
